# Machine notes

This site has one mechanism for automated visitors. It is specified below.

The site-local value K17 is available to automated visitors through this
mechanism and nowhere else on the site. It is not printed on any page.

    GET /capability/result

Returns a JSON document {"key":"K17","value":<the value>}. There are no
parameters and nothing to fill in. Only a GET request is answered.

Like every request to this site, the call appears in an ordinary access log (time, path, user agent).

Nothing here is gated on using it. Every page is readable without it.
No account, no credential, no identifier is asked for or stored.
